name: AR_CMGT_CASE_FOLDERS
description: This table contains the credit case folders.

columns.name: CASE_FOLDER_ID
columns.description: Case folder unique identifier.

columns.name: CASE_FOLDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Case folder number.

columns.name: CF_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Case folder template unique identifier.

columns.name: CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Credit classifcation of the customer or customer account. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Case folder description.

columns.name: REVIEW_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of credit review for the case folder. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_REVIEW_TYPE.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Case folder status. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_CASE_FOLDER_STATUS.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Case folder currency code.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique party identifier of the customer that the case folder is created for.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer account that the case folder is created for.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Customer name.

columns.name: SCORE_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Scoring model unique identifier.

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: Credit score calculated using the scoring model and data point values for the customer.

columns.name: CREDIT_ANALYST_ID
columns.description: Credit analyst Identifier.

columns.name: CURRENT_APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Current approver identifier.

columns.name: CREDIT_LIMIT_AMT
columns.description: The current credit limit amount assigned to the customer.

columns.name: AVBL_LIMIT_AMT
columns.description: The credit amount that is currently available to the customer.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for the case folder.

columns.name: REVIEW_CYCLE_CODE
columns.description: Periodic review cycle defined for the customer or customer account. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_REVIEW_CYCLE.

columns.name: SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Source application from which the credit review originated.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source transation type.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Source Transaction currency code.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Source transaction contact identifier.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_NUM
columns.description: Source transaction number.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Requested amount by the source transaction.

columns.name: MISS_DATA_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the case folder is missing required data points, a credit score, or both.

columns.name: RECOM_FAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the implementation of recommendations has failed for the case folder.

columns.name: CREDIT_HOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the customer is on credit hold.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANS_CONTACT
columns.description: Source transaction contact name

columns.name: CREDIT_CHECK_REQUESTER_GUID
columns.description: User who has requested the credit check for a customer or a customer account.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for credit check notification.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of price structure associated with the requested amount.

columns.name: RECURRENCE_PERIOD
columns.description: Recurrence period when the price type is not one-time.

columns.name: REQUEST_AUTH_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount requested for credit authorization.

columns.name: REQUEST_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency associated with the requested authorization amount.

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date and time on which estimated fulfilment occurs for the source transaction.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_DATE
columns.description: The estimated date that goods will be shipped to the customer for the source transaction.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: The date the source transaction (sales order) is created.

columns.name: OFFSET_DAYS
columns.description: The offset days allowed before an authorization becomes expired.

columns.name: REQUESTOR
columns.description: The user or system initiating the credit checking request.

columns.name: ORDER_AMOUNT_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum order amount defined in the credit currency for the customer account.

columns.name: REQUEST_CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer account associated with the credit authorization.

columns.name: PREAUTH_REQUEST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the request is a preauthorization credit checking request.

columns.name: SCORE_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: This column identifies the date and time the case folder score was last updated.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_VALUE_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: This column identifies whether a more recently updated value is available for this data point in the unified repository.
